# glyhub <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="glyhub logo" />

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
<!-- badges: end -->

glyhub collects glycomics and glycoproteomics data for the Glycoverse ecosystem,
using the [`GlycomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycomicSE.html)
and [`GlycoproteomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycoproteomicSE.html) containers from
[glyexp](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyexp). The package is experimental.

## Available data

75 datasets from 47 public GlycoPOST projects are bundled, including released
glycans, glycosaminoglycan disaccharides and site/charge-resolved glycopeptides.
Objects combine source-defined quantitative tables from the same study and glycan
class where measurement definitions are compatible. GPST000602 is explicitly an
annotated-peak subset with spectrum-specific, unaligned feature identities.
Inclusion does not imply recovery of every experiment in its paper.

Each dataset has its own help page describing the biological system, experimental
design, units, source table and limitations. Use `data(package = "glyhub")` for the
installed catalog. N/O classes remain separate; source experiments, sample conditions and replicate
labels remain in `colData`. Feature unions use documented author keys or supported
structures, with an explicit source-coverage mask for unmeasured combinations.

**For GlycoPOST datasets, zero-valued abundances are stored as NA in the distributed assays.** Original
values, source-missing values and conflict masks remain in metadata. No imputation
or renormalization is applied. Unknown molecular annotations remain NA without
removing quantitative rows. Structures are encoded only from explicit source
structural evidence. Unresolved bonds and attachment positions remain uncertain.

## Installation

Install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub):

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub")
```

## Example

```{r}
x <- glyhub::glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1
dim(x)
data.frame(as.list(S4Vectors::metadata(x)$processing_counts))
```

Data use R's LazyData mechanism. `SummarizedExperiment::assay(x)` contains the
curated abundance matrix; `S4Vectors::metadata(x)$raw_abundance` preserves the
unconverted values. `rowData(x)` retains typed glyrepr annotations and source
evidence, and `colData(x)` retains source conditions and observation locations.

## CPTAC glycoproteomes

Eight JHU GENCODEv34 N-glycoform-peptide matrices are available through
`glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC()`, `glyhub_CPTAC_COAD()`, `glyhub_CPTAC_HGSC()`,
`glyhub_CPTAC_HNSCC()`, `glyhub_CPTAC_LSCC()`, `glyhub_CPTAC_LUAD()`,
`glyhub_CPTAC_PDAC()` and `glyhub_CPTAC_UCEC()`.
These are loader functions, rather than the LazyData objects listed above.

```{r}
glyhub::glyhub_cptac_catalog()[, c("dataset", "kind", "storage", "bytes")]
```

```r
x <- glyhub::glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC() # Download once, then use the verified cache
x <- glyhub::glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC(offline = TRUE)
raw_file <- glyhub::glyhub_cptac_download("CCRCC", kind = "raw")
```

Curated files up to 2 MiB (xz-compressed RDS) are bundled; larger datasets
are downloaded on demand. Raw TSV gzip archives and all curated RDS files
are preserved in the [versioned data release](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/releases/tag/cptac-data-v1).
No large source files are tracked by Git. Downloads are checked against the
package's SHA-256 manifest. `cache_dir` or option `glyhub.cache_dir` selects
the cache; `refresh = TRUE` downloads a fresh copy. An offline call requires
a valid cached or bundled file. Remove downloaded files to clear the cache.

The assay contains **linearized abundance (`2^source log2 value`)**.
`metadata(x)$raw_abundance` preserves the source log2 matrix, including zeros;
`None` is represented as `NA`. No features or measurement columns are dropped.
Reference, QC and unresolved sample roles remain annotated in `colData`.
Absolute protein sites and protein accessions are unavailable and remain `NA`;
source peptide, gene and glycan-composition labels are retained in `rowData`.
The matrices do not establish independent patients for every measurement column.

Five supplied files match upstream MD5 checksums exactly. COAD and PDAC match
CRC and PDA after reversing sample-column prefix renaming. HGSC has not been
matched to the supplied upstream checksum list; its fractionation identity
remains unverified. These limitations are recorded in each object's provenance.

Source: [CPTAC Pan-Cancer](https://pdc.cancer.gov/pdc/cptac-pancancer).
Follow [PDC data-use and attribution guidelines](https://pdc.cancer.gov/pdc/data-use-guidelines);
the package's MIT code license does not license the source data.
